sonnet.problem: The card says Rachel 'turns to her maidservant, Bilhah, with an idea'. The text has Rachel speaking to Jacob (30:3), and card 15's own question says she tells Jacob. The card adds a scene the text doesn't give and contradicts the next card.
sonnet.rule: Retelling: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.
